Name: Four Seasons Farm improved version (Type Standard)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1]This is an improved version of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5519]Four Seasons Farm (Type Standard)
[/url][/color]
We expanded the farmland and added several bridges to make life easier.Other minor corrections were made.
You can also choose a pattern without shortcuts.


[color=#f1f1f1]Select a standard farm.[/color]

Shortcuts are not immediately available at the start of the game because each is blocked by a large tree and a large rock.

Shortcuts to the sewer have different entrances and exits due to flags.


Note:
The options file makes the shortcut file compatible with SVE.
When introducing this, delete the folder of T's MAP Collection>[TMX] T's Useful shortcuts (Four Seasons Farm improved version (Type Standard)) in the main file.
SVE compatibility is probably not perfect.I have not implemented SVE, so verification is not enough.If you find an issue, please send us a comment or bug report.

v1.1~
You can change the settings to allow planting of all seasonal seeds from mod config.See the top page for details.
"Seeds of every season grow" The default setting is false.
If changed to true in-game, the change will be applied when the in-game clock advances.
Conversely, if you change the value from true to false, please go back to the title and reload the game.

v1.2~
Added a setting so that it can be used in co-op.
Fixed an issue where the shortcut from the ocean would get stuck if the tree blocking it was not removed.
